# @actor-kit/worker docs

These pages ship with the package so they match the version you installed. The whole site is at
https://actorkit.dev; agents can read https://actorkit.dev/llms.txt (an index) or https://actorkit.dev/llms-full.txt (everything in one file).

- [Quick Start](getting-started-quick-start.md): Build a real-time counter in under 5 minutes.
- [Actors & State](concepts-actors-and-state.md): How actors work and how state is managed.
- [Authentication](concepts-authentication.md): How to authenticate clients connecting to your actors. The library is auth-agnostic — your Worker owns identity.
- [Roles & Authorization](concepts-roles-and-authorization.md): How roles work and how authorization is enforced.
- [Messages & Guards](concepts-messages-and-guards.md): How messages are validated and how guards work.
- [Views](concepts-views.md): Schema-defined views with per-role projections.
- [Side Effects](concepts-side-effects.md): Durable async effects via services and execute().
- [Timers](concepts-timers.md): Durable timers that survive hibernation, restarts and deploys.
- [Domain events](concepts-domain-events.md): Record what happened, not only what was asked for, with typed ctx.emit.
- [States](concepts-states.md): Phases with typed locals and state-scoped timers, nested as deep as the game needs.
- [Actor-to-Actor Communication](recipes-actor-to-actor.md): How actors sync state, forward events, and call each other using links, services, and DO stubs.
- [Scaling with Relays](recipes-scaling-with-relays.md): Handle thousands of connections using relay actors.
- [@actor-kit/core & @actor-kit/worker](api-core.md): Server-side API reference.
- [Upgrading to 0.3](upgrading-0.3.md): one note per breaking change, with code before and after.
